zh.title: H3K27me3 与成熟启动
zh.intro: 从动态标记走向主动去除与功能验证。
zh.leads: 现有归档包括种皮 H3K27me3 主动去除、CrJAG 相关染色质变化和果实多组学研究。这些研究为解释成熟时的标记变化提供不同层次的参照，但不构成辣椒中的统一因果模型。
zh.methods: 比较 H3K27me3、ATAC、H3K27ac 与 RNA 的共同变化；结合 JMJ 候选基因、靶位点检测和遗传扰动。
zh.questions: 主动去甲基化与复制稀释如何区分？哪些变化反映细胞组成差异？JMJ 与 PRC2 在不同组织中的贡献是否不同？
zh.caution: 本专题未完成系统综述或相反结果的全面收集。跨物种结果、不同组织的标记变化和局部证据不能直接互相替代。

en.title: H3K27me3 and ripening initiation
en.intro: Move from dynamic marks to active removal and functional tests.
en.leads: The archive includes active H3K27me3 removal in seed coats, CrJAG-associated chromatin changes and fruit multi-omics studies. They offer different levels of reference, not a unified causal model in pepper.
en.methods: Compare coordinated H3K27me3, ATAC, H3K27ac and RNA changes; combine JMJ candidates with locus-specific assays and genetic perturbation.
en.questions: How can active demethylation be distinguished from replication dilution? Which changes reflect cell composition? Do JMJ and PRC2 contributions differ across tissues?
en.caution: This is not a systematic review or a comprehensive collection of conflicting results. Cross-species findings, tissue changes and local evidence are not interchangeable.

zh.title: 果实 TF 调控网络
zh.intro: 从 motif 和 footprint 筛选，走向可检验的 TF–靶基因关系。
zh.leads: 位置语法、复合 motif 和单分子可及性研究提示，仅凭一个 motif 或最近基因注释不足以解释调控。现有归档可用于比较不同候选排序方式。
zh.methods: 区分 proximal、distal 与 intronic ACR；分析 motif 组合、间距和方向；结合表达、染色质状态与直接结合或功能验证。
zh.questions: footprint 变化是否反映 TF 活性还是细胞混合？远端 ACR 应连接哪个靶基因？哪些候选能优先进入 VIGS 或其他扰动实验？
zh.caution: 计算预测、motif 共现和开放程度均不能单独证明直接调控。尚未系统比较不同模型在辣椒中的准确性。

en.title: Fruit TF regulatory networks
en.intro: Turn motifs and footprints into testable TF–target relationships.
en.leads: Positional grammar, composite motifs and single-molecule accessibility suggest that a motif or nearest-gene annotation alone is insufficient. The archive supports comparison of candidate-prioritization strategies.
en.methods: Separate proximal, distal and intronic ACRs; analyze motif combinations, spacing and orientation; integrate expression and chromatin with binding or functional tests.
en.questions: Do footprint changes reflect TF activity or mixed cells? Which gene does a distal ACR regulate? Which candidates should enter VIGS or other perturbation tests?
en.caution: Predictions, motif co-occurrence and accessibility do not independently establish direct regulation. Model accuracy in pepper has not been systematically compared here.

zh.title: 22 组织表观图谱
zh.intro: 让不同组织和组学之间的比较可解释、可追溯。
zh.leads: 当前归档覆盖三维基因组整合、甲基化区域分层、单核联合测量和数据库架构，可分别借鉴数据组织、解释框架与验证设计。
zh.methods: 统一基因和组织标识；记录阶段配对关系；按基因区域与甲基化 context 分层；保留样本元数据和分析来源。
zh.questions: 组织间状态转换是否受到测序深度或细胞组成影响？哪些组学可以严格配对？不同区域的甲基化与表达关系是否一致？
zh.caution: 专题内的数据来自不同物种、组织和实验体系，不宜把方法名称相同理解为数据可以直接合并。

en.title: The 22-tissue epigenomic atlas
en.intro: Make cross-tissue and cross-omics comparisons interpretable and traceable.
en.leads: The archive covers 3D genome integration, position-specific methylation, joint single-nucleus measurements and database architecture, providing complementary data and analysis references.
en.methods: Unify gene and tissue identifiers; record stage correspondence; stratify by genomic region and methylation context; retain sample metadata and analytical provenance.
en.questions: Do depth or cell composition affect state transitions? Which omics are strictly matched? Are methylation–expression relationships consistent across genomic regions?
en.caution: The studies use different species, tissues and experimental systems. A shared method name does not mean their data can be pooled directly.

zh.title: 果实代谢与表观调控
zh.intro: 把类胡萝卜素、辣椒素、糖和激素连接到可验证的调控链。
zh.leads: 当前归档中与代谢直接相关的材料有限，主要提供果实成熟、激素响应和多组学方法线索；尚不能据此概括辣椒素或糖代谢的完整表观机制。
zh.methods: 将代谢物变化与通路基因、候选 TF 和染色质变化配对；先检查取样阶段和检测覆盖，再做跨层关联。
zh.questions: 哪些代谢变化有匹配的转录和染色质证据？激素效应是直接调控还是发育阶段改变的结果？关键代谢物是否被可靠定量？
zh.caution: 不同代谢检测平台的覆盖范围不同。未检测到某种代谢物不等于其不存在；当前专题仍需要更多直接机制论文。

en.title: Fruit metabolism and epigenetic regulation
en.intro: Connect carotenoids, capsaicinoids, sugars and hormones to testable regulatory chains.
en.leads: Direct metabolic evidence in the current archive is limited. The papers mainly provide ripening, hormone-response and integration methods, not a complete epigenetic model for capsaicinoid or sugar metabolism.
en.methods: Match metabolites to pathway genes, candidate TFs and chromatin changes; check sampling stages and assay coverage before cross-layer association.
en.questions: Which metabolic changes have matched transcriptional and chromatin evidence? Are hormonal effects direct or mediated by developmental timing? Were the key metabolites quantified reliably?
en.caution: Metabolomics platforms differ in coverage. Failure to detect a metabolite does not establish its absence, and this topic needs more direct mechanistic studies.
